title: Especialista Finops
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista Finops em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW. Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal! Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível: Especialista FinOps Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista FinOps para liderar iniciativas de governança financeira em ambientes cloud, promovendo a otimização contínua de custos, eficiência operacional e maximização do retorno dos investimentos em tecnologia. O profissional atuará como referência técnica e estratégica em FinOps, colaborando diretamente com equipes de Arquitetura, Infraestrutura, Engenharia, Finanças, Produtos e Liderança Executiva. Sua missão será transformar dados de consumo em decisões inteligentes, garantindo governança, previsibilidade financeira e uso eficiente dos recursos em nuvem. Buscamos um perfil altamente analítico, consultivo e orientado a resultados, capaz de influenciar decisões técnicas e financeiras em ambientes corporativos de grande porte. Principais Responsabilidades Gestão e Otimização Financeira de Cloud Identificar continuamente oportunidades de redução de custos e aumento da eficiência operacional em ambientes Microsoft Azure;
Realizar análises detalhadas de consumo, utilização e desperdício de recursos cloud;
Propor estratégias derightsizing, otimização de workloads, reclassificação de recursos e ajustes de provisionamento;
Gerenciar e otimizar o uso de Reservations, Savings Plans e demais mecanismos de redução de custos;
Monitorar desvios orçamentários, anomalias de consumo e oportunidades de savings. Governança FinOps e Controle Financeiro Definir e implementar políticas, padrões e diretrizes de governança financeira para ambientes cloud;
Estruturar e evoluir processos de chargeback, showback e alocação de custos;
Garantir a correta utilização de tags, taxonomias e estruturas financeiras;
Atuar na definição demodelos de accountability financeira entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia;
Participar de fóruns,comitês de governança e iniciativas de evolução da maturidade FinOps. Planejamento Financeiro e Inteligência de Custos Desenvolver modelos de previsão de consumo e gastos (forecast);
Realizar análises preditivas baseadas em tendências e históricos de utilização;
Avaliar impactos financeiros de novos projetos, arquiteturas e iniciativas cloud;
Apoiar a construção de business cases, análises de ROI, TCO e planejamento orçamentário;
Estruturar KPIse indicadores estratégicos para acompanhamento financeiro dos ambientes cloud. Suporte Consultivo às Equipes Técnicas Atuar como parceiro estratégico das áreas de Engenharia, Infraestrutura e Arquitetura;
Traduzir decisões técnicas em impactos financeiros para apoiar a tomada de decisão;
Recomendar arquiteturas mais eficientes, escaláveis e economicamente sustentáveis;
Promover a cultura FinOps e disseminar boas práticas de otimização e governança. Automação e Observabilidade Desenvolver scripts, automações e mecanismos de controle preventivo;
Implementar budgets, alertas, políticas e monitoramentos automatizados;
Construir dashboards executivos e operacionais para visibilidade dos custos;
Integrar dados financeiros com ferramentas de observabilidade e gestão cloud;
Promover automação deprocessos relacionados à governança financeira. Compliance e Gestão de Contratos Garantir aderência às políticas internas e requisitos regulatórios relacionados ao uso da nuvem;
Monitorar desperdícios e definir ações corretivas para mitigação de custos desnecessários;
Apoiar a gestãode contratos, licenciamento e compromissos financeiros cloud;
Atuar na evolução da maturidade FinOps seguindo o modelo FinOps Foundation (Crawl → Walk → Run → Fly). Requisitos Obrigatórios Microsoft Azure Experiência avançada em ambientes corporativos Azure;
Conhecimento aprofundado dos serviços e componentes da plataforma;
Experiência prática com:Azure Cost Management Azure Advisor Azure Reservations Azure Policies Management Groups Billing Management Resource Governance FinOps e Governança Financeira Conhecimento avançado dos princípios e práticas da FinOps Foundation;
Gestão de Chargeback e Showback;
Modelagem financeira para ambientes cloud;
Gestão de Forecast e Budget;
Planejamento e governança financeira de recursos tecnológicos;
Gestão de contratos, reservas e compromissos financeiros cloud. Dados, Métricas e Indicadores Construção de dashboards e relatórios executivos;
Definição e acompanhamento de KPIs FinOps;
Análise financeira e operacional de ambientes cloud;
Visibilidade e rastreabilidade de custos. Automação Experiência com automação de processos e controles cloud;
Desenvolvimentode scripts para monitoramento, governança e otimização;
Implementação de alertas, budgets e controles automatizados. Diferenciais Certificação FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP);
Certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-305 ou equivalentes);
Experiência em Arquitetura Cloud ou Infraestrutura;
Vivência em ambientesmulticloud;
Conhecimento emPower BI;
Experiência comInfrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep ou similares);
Conhecimento emAWS Cost Management ou Google Cloud FinOps;
Participação emprogramas de transformação digital e otimização financeira em nuvem. Hard Skills FinOps (Especialista) Microsoft Azure (Especialista) Azure Cost Management (Especialista) Azure Advisor (Especialista) Azure Reservations (Especialista) Azure Policies (Especialista) Governança Cloud (Especialista) Gestão de Reservas e Savings Plans (Especialista) Chargeback & Showback (Especialista) Forecast Financeiro (Especialista) Controle Orçamentário (Especialista) KPIs e Métricas FinOps (Especialista) Automação de Controles (Especialista) Observabilidade Financeira (Especialista) Dashboards e Analytics (Especialista) ROI e TCO (Especialista) Metodologias e Frameworks FinOps Foundation Cloud Financial Management Chargeback & Showback Forecasting & Budget Management Governance & Compliance Cloud Cost Optimization Continuous Improvement FinOps Maturity Model (Crawl, Walk, Run, Fly) E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens! Assistência médica;
VR e VA flexível;
Gympass e Wellz;
Parceria com o SESC;
Descontos em restaurantes;
Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;
Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas. E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua inscrição e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WHO ARE WE? We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy! CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention. Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including: CloudSEK’s Product Suite: CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support. A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets. CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies. Key Milestones: 2016: Launched our first product. 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding. 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas. 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year. 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures. Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's\ "Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award. 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault. Job Description: As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients. Key Responsibilities: Account Management: Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement. Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs. Cybersecurity Expertise: Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues. Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform. Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions. Customer Engagement: Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs. Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals. Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery. Revenue Generation and Retention: Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services. Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate. Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities. Product Usage and Feedback: Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers. Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements. Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement. Operational Excellence: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems. Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles. Ideal candidate: 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry. Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required. Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth. Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously. Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills: Business reviews: Onsite meetings Maintaining NRR and GRR Threat analysis and Value delivery Benefits of Joining CloudSEK: We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include: Flexible working hours. Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office. And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here! CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Global Ta Manager (Contractor Role)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Global Ta Manager (Contractor Role) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote (Based in Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, or Brazil) Contract Duration: 6 months (with potential for extension/long-term partnership) Compensation: Base Rate + Performance-Based Placement Bonus (Earn extra for every successful hire!) Role Overview We are stripping away the corporate red tape. This role is built for one thing and one thing only: Pure, High-Velocity Recruitment Delivery. As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U.S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground. What You Will Do- High-Volume Sourcing & Delivery: Own the end-to-end sourcing and pipeline management for mid-to-senior global roles. You will hunt via LinkedIn, regional job boards, GitHub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast. The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U.S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset. Core Traits (Soft Skills): The "Bias for Action" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack. What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind. The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts. If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let's talk. Apply now and let's make a global impact together!

title: Líder Sênior De Aquisição De Talentos E Headhunting
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Líder Sênior De Aquisição De Talentos E Headhunting em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Detalhes da Vaga Cargo: Líder Sênior de Aquisição de Talentos e Headhunting Empresa: Liza, plataforma educacional de IA Localização: Remoto, com preferência por profissionais no Brasil Idioma: Português obrigatório;
inglês é um grande diferencial Experiência: Mais de 5 anos em recrutamento, headhunting, busca executiva ou aquisição de talentos Tipo de contratação: PJ Remuneração: R$ 8.000 a R$ 10.000 por mês Sobre a Liza A Liza é uma plataforma educacional de inteligência artificial que ajuda escolas, professores, coordenadores pedagógicos e secretarias municipais de educação a aprimorar o planejamento de aulas, as atividades em sala, os registros dos alunos, os relatórios e a gestão pedagógica. Estamos crescendo rapidamente e formando uma equipe sólida nas áreas de vendas, implantação, pedagogia, sucesso do cliente e operações. À medida que crescemos, precisamos contratar profissionais que não sejam apenas experientes, mas também responsáveis, proativos, estáveis e capazes de resolver problemas de forma independente. Estamos procurando um(a) Líder Sênior de Aquisição de Talentos e Headhunting para nos ajudar a desenvolver um sistema de contratação mais eficiente e atrair profissionais de alta qualidade para a empresa. Sobre a Função Esta não é uma função tradicional de administração de Recursos Humanos. Procuramos alguém com sólida experiência em headhunting, busca ativa e avaliação de talentos. Essa pessoa deverá abordar ativamente profissionais qualificados, inclusive aqueles que não estejam procurando uma nova oportunidade no momento. O candidato ideal possui mais de cinco anos de experiência em recrutamento, headhunting, busca executiva ou aquisição de talentos. Também deve ter trabalhado em uma empresa de grande porte, consolidada ou com processos bem estruturados, além de apresentar uma trajetória profissional estável, com períodos relevantes de permanência em cargos anteriores. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com a equipe de liderança para definir as necessidades de contratação, identificar bons candidatos, realizar abordagens, fazer triagens, estruturar processos seletivos e ajudar a empresa a contratar profissionais com verdadeiro senso de responsabilidade, autonomia, capacidade de resolver problemas e alto nível de execução. Principais Responsabilidades Criar e gerenciar pipelines de recrutamento para posições estratégicas nas áreas de vendas, implantação, pedagogia, sucesso do cliente, operações e liderança. Buscar candidatos de forma proativa por meio do LinkedIn, indicações, redes profissionais, redes da área de educação, plataformas de recrutamento e abordagens diretas. Identificar candidatos passivos de alta qualidade que talvez não estejam procurando novas oportunidades ativamente. Abordar potenciais candidatos de maneira profissional e persuasiva. Elaborar descrições de vagas claras e atrativas, baseadas nas necessidades reais do negócio. Avaliar candidatos considerando experiência, capacidade de comunicação, responsabilidade, senso de dono, habilidade para resolver problemas e compatibilidade de longo prazo com a empresa. Avaliar os candidatos para além do currículo e do desempenho nas entrevistas. Estruturar processos de entrevista e matrizes de avaliação para diferentes funções. Criar estudos de caso e atividades práticas para verificar se os candidatos realmente sabem pensar, resolver problemas e executar. Coordenar entrevistas com a liderança e os gestores responsáveis pelas contratações. Realizar verificações de referências profissionais e apoiar as decisões finais de contratação. Reduzir a dependência de headhunters externos de alto custo por meio da construção de um sistema interno de aquisição de talentos. Apoiar o processo de integração e a avaliação inicial de desempenho durante os primeiros 30 a 60 dias. Ajudar a liderança a identificar rapidamente quando um candidato ou novo contratado pode não ser adequado para a função ou para a empresa. Desenvolver um processo de contratação replicável, disciplinado e profissional. Requisitos Obrigatórios Mais de cinco anos de experiência em recrutamento, headhunting, busca executiva ou aquisição de talentos. Experiência comprovada em busca ativa e abordagem direta de candidatos, e não apenas no gerenciamento de candidaturas recebidas. Experiência anterior em uma empresa de grande porte, consolidada ou com processos bem estruturados. Trajetória profissional estável, com permanência relevante em cargos anteriores, geralmente superior a um ano em cada empresa ou função. Forte capacidade de busca de candidatos por meio do LinkedIn, indicações, redes profissionais e abordagens diretas. Capacidade de avaliar candidatos para além do currículo. Bom julgamento para identificar profissionais com senso de dono, responsabilidade, maturidade e capacidade de resolver problemas. Experiência conduzindo processos seletivos para várias posições simultaneamente. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, acompanhamento e coordenação. Alto nível de organização e disciplina, com forte compromisso com prazos. Facilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente de startup dinâmico e em rápido crescimento. Fluência em português. Inglês será um grande diferencial. Qualificações Desejáveis Experiência como headhunter ou em agência de recrutamento. Experiência recrutando para empresas de EdTech, SaaS, inteligência artificial, educação, tecnologia ou startups. Experiência em contratações para as áreas de vendas, implantação, sucesso do cliente, operações, pedagogia ou liderança. Experiência recrutando profissionais seniores ou candidatos difíceis de encontrar. Familiaridade com o mercado de talentos brasileiro. Experiência na criação de matrizes de avaliação, estruturas de entrevistas e sistemas de avaliação de candidatos. Experiência trabalhando diretamente com fundadores, executivos ou equipes de alta liderança. O Que Procuramos Procuramos alguém que não seja apenas um recrutador, mas um verdadeiro caçador de talentos e parceiro estratégico de contratação. Você deverá ser capaz de compreender qual tipo de profissional a empresa realmente precisa, transformar necessidades de contratação pouco definidas em um perfil claro de candidato, encontrar profissionais qualificados de forma proativa e nos ajudar a evitar a contratação de pessoas que gerem mais necessidade de gestão do que valor para a empresa. A pessoa ideal é profissional, estável, madura, organizada e proativa. Deve trazer a disciplina e a estrutura de uma empresa maior, ao mesmo tempo que se sente confortável trabalhando em uma startup dinâmica, na qual as prioridades podem mudar rapidamente. Para Quem Esta Vaga Não É Indicada Esta vaga não é indicada para alguém que queira atuar apenas com atividades administrativas de Recursos Humanos. description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Responsibilities: Job Title: Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst Introduction: We are seeking an experienced Global Trade Compliance Business Analyst to join our team and play a critical role in supporting the business across a broad spectrum of global import and export compliance matters. This position is vital in ensuring our compliance with international trade regulations while enabling data-driven decision-making through the creation of innovative dashboards and reports. The successful candidate will leverage their expertise in global trade compliance and advanced analytics tools to model the potential impact of tariffs on the business model and drive continuous improvement in compliance processes. Roles and Responsibilities: Collaborate with regional trade compliance teams and business stakeholders to gather, document, and refine business requirements and functional processes, adapting them as business needs evolve. Maintain and oversee day-to-day global classification processes to support global import volumes, ensuring accuracy and compliance. Assist with technology, hardware, and software trade classification, including management of Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS), Schedule B, and Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) classifications. Manage compliance activities equally focused on imports and exports (50% each). Develop and contribute to documented classification justifications based on the General Rules of Interpretation (GRI) foundation for global import classifications. Provide import compliance guidance in adherence to US and international regulations, including conducting research, updating status reports, and coordinating deliverables within the team. Build, maintain, and analyze data-informed metrics to generate actionable insights that enhance the global trade compliance program. Establish and nurture positive business relationships with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams. Engage with software development teams to understand and influence evolving compliance technology, identifying opportunities to automate manual processes. Generate and contribute to performance requirements, timelines, and metrics for all related activities. Support project management efforts to ensure timely delivery of team assignments and objectives. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, preferably within supply chain, logistics, or global trade compliance environments. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear documentation including Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and detailed reports. Proven experience with global trade compliance regulations, including import/export laws and logistics preferred. Demonstrated ability to independently research and dive deep into complex compliance requests and issues. Tools and Technologies: Proficient in Smartsheet, Power BI, and AWS Quicksight with hands-on experience creating new dashboards, running data batches, and developing meaningful metrics and reports. Strong data analytics and data entry skills to support compliance reporting and insights generation. Familiarity with trade classification tools and regulatory databases is a plus. Skills: Global trade compliance, Smartsheet, Power BI, AWS Quicksight

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina. Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma. Temos um desafio para as pessoas que: Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites. Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação. Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros. A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas. Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão. Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe. Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por: Liderar time de 10 executivos hunters responsável por adquirir e desenvolver o relacionamento com empresas varejistas e prestadores de serviço com faturamento superior a R$ 30 mil. Desenvolver uma equipe de talentos, potencializando seu resultado a partir da excelência na execução, melhor experiência para os usuários, estratégias comerciais e um excelente clima. Colaborar para o desenvolvimento da proposta de valor e estratégia do segmento. Requisitos: Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando. Ter experiência consistente de vendas em empresas adquirentes ou de entregas porta a porta. Conhecer profundamente a região de atuação;
Experiência consistente em liderar equipes comerciais;
Estar disponível paratrabalhar na região: Feira de Santana - BA Nós lhe propomos: Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo. Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores. Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas. Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :) No Mercado Livre, trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferentes perspectivas. Isso se traduz em Gênero, Religião, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQ+, Etnia e diversidade de experiências. Trabalhamos todas as nossas vagas com base nessa premissa. Faça parte do nosso time!

title: Analista De Suporte De Infraestrutura
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Suporte De Infraestrutura em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance. Sobre o Cargo: Analista de Infraestrutura Júnior Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Infraestrutura Júnior para atuar em atividades de suporte, sustentação e operação de ambientes de infraestrutura, com foco em servidores Linux e Windows, banco de dados e atendimento técnico a clientes e usuários. Requisitos técnicos Conhecimentos em sistemas operacionais Linux, incluindo comandos gerais, navegação em diretórios, permissões, análise de logs, processos, serviços e conectividade. Conhecimento em SQL para consultas, validações e apoio em análises técnicas. Noções de infraestrutura, redes, servidores, ambientes corporativos e sustentação de sistemas. Conhecimento em comandos gerais de Linux e Windows. Conhecimento ou familiaridade com VCX e outras ferramentas relacionadas ao ambiente do cliente será considerado diferencial. Requisitos comportamentais Perfil júnior com forte vontade de aprender e se desenvolver tecnicamente. Boa comunicação para contato com clientes, usuários e equipes internas. Organização, responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes. Proatividade para buscar soluções e apoiar o time técnico. Capacidade de atuar sob orientação, seguindo procedimentos e boas práticas. Disponibilidade para plantão, quando necessário. Idioma Inglês intermediário, principalmente para contato com clientes, usuários e leitura de documentações técnicas. Perfil desejado Profissional em início de carreira ou com experiência inicial em infraestrutura, suporte técnico, operação de ambientes ou sustentação de sistemas, que tenha interesse em evoluir em ambientes Linux, Windows Server, banco de dados e atendimento técnico corporativo. Formação em T.I. ou áreas similares. title: Designer De Apresentações (Pleno/Sênior) - Banco De Talentos
description:

Atuar em reuniões de briefing e colaborar diretamente com stakeholders para transformar informações complexas em storytelling claros, objetivos e visualmente impactantes;
Trabalhar com materiais médicos e científicos, assegurando alto nível de precisão, atenção a detalhes e tratamento adequado de dados, além de transformar conteúdos técnicos e densos em apresentações visualmente atraentes, organizadas e de fácil compreensão;

title: Líder Sênior De Aquisição De Talentos E Headhunting
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Líder Sênior De Aquisição De Talentos E Headhunting em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Detalhes da Vaga Cargo: Líder Sênior de Aquisição de Talentos e Headhunting Empresa: Liza, plataforma educacional de IA Localização: Remoto, com preferência por profissionais no Brasil Idioma: Português obrigatório;
inglês é um grande diferencial Experiência: Mais de 5 anos em recrutamento, headhunting, busca executiva ou aquisição de talentos Tipo de contratação: PJ Remuneração: R$ 8.000 a R$ 10.000 por mês Sobre a Liza A Liza é uma plataforma educacional de inteligência artificial que ajuda escolas, professores, coordenadores pedagógicos e secretarias municipais de educação a aprimorar o planejamento de aulas, as atividades em sala, os registros dos alunos, os relatórios e a gestão pedagógica. Estamos crescendo rapidamente e formando uma equipe sólida nas áreas de vendas, implantação, pedagogia, sucesso do cliente e operações. À medida que crescemos, precisamos contratar profissionais que não sejam apenas experientes, mas também responsáveis, proativos, estáveis e capazes de resolver problemas de forma independente. Estamos procurando um(a) Líder Sênior de Aquisição de Talentos e Headhunting para nos ajudar a desenvolver um sistema de contratação mais eficiente e atrair profissionais de alta qualidade para a empresa. Sobre a Função Esta não é uma função tradicional de administração de Recursos Humanos. Procuramos alguém com sólida experiência em headhunting, busca ativa e avaliação de talentos. Essa pessoa deverá abordar ativamente profissionais qualificados, inclusive aqueles que não estejam procurando uma nova oportunidade no momento. O candidato ideal possui mais de cinco anos de experiência em recrutamento, headhunting, busca executiva ou aquisição de talentos. Também deve ter trabalhado em uma empresa de grande porte, consolidada ou com processos bem estruturados, além de apresentar uma trajetória profissional estável, com períodos relevantes de permanência em cargos anteriores. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com a equipe de liderança para definir as necessidades de contratação, identificar bons candidatos, realizar abordagens, fazer triagens, estruturar processos seletivos e ajudar a empresa a contratar profissionais com verdadeiro senso de responsabilidade, autonomia, capacidade de resolver problemas e alto nível de execução. Principais Responsabilidades Criar e gerenciar pipelines de recrutamento para posições estratégicas nas áreas de vendas, implantação, pedagogia, sucesso do cliente, operações e liderança. Buscar candidatos de forma proativa por meio do LinkedIn, indicações, redes profissionais, redes da área de educação, plataformas de recrutamento e abordagens diretas. Identificar candidatos passivos de alta qualidade que talvez não estejam procurando novas oportunidades ativamente. Abordar potenciais candidatos de maneira profissional e persuasiva. Elaborar descrições de vagas claras e atrativas, baseadas nas necessidades reais do negócio. Avaliar candidatos considerando experiência, capacidade de comunicação, responsabilidade, senso de dono, habilidade para resolver problemas e compatibilidade de longo prazo com a empresa. Avaliar os candidatos para além do currículo e do desempenho nas entrevistas. Estruturar processos de entrevista e matrizes de avaliação para diferentes funções. Criar estudos de caso e atividades práticas para verificar se os candidatos realmente sabem pensar, resolver problemas e executar. Coordenar entrevistas com a liderança e os gestores responsáveis pelas contratações. Realizar verificações de referências profissionais e apoiar as decisões finais de contratação. Reduzir a dependência de headhunters externos de alto custo por meio da construção de um sistema interno de aquisição de talentos. Apoiar o processo de integração e a avaliação inicial de desempenho durante os primeiros 30 a 60 dias. Ajudar a liderança a identificar rapidamente quando um candidato ou novo contratado pode não ser adequado para a função ou para a empresa. Desenvolver um processo de contratação replicável, disciplinado e profissional. Requisitos Obrigatórios Mais de cinco anos de experiência em recrutamento, headhunting, busca executiva ou aquisição de talentos. Experiência comprovada em busca ativa e abordagem direta de candidatos, e não apenas no gerenciamento de candidaturas recebidas. Experiência anterior em uma empresa de grande porte, consolidada ou com processos bem estruturados. Trajetória profissional estável, com permanência relevante em cargos anteriores, geralmente superior a um ano em cada empresa ou função. Forte capacidade de busca de candidatos por meio do LinkedIn, indicações, redes profissionais e abordagens diretas. Capacidade de avaliar candidatos para além do currículo. Bom julgamento para identificar profissionais com senso de dono, responsabilidade, maturidade e capacidade de resolver problemas. Experiência conduzindo processos seletivos para várias posições simultaneamente. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, acompanhamento e coordenação. Alto nível de organização e disciplina, com forte compromisso com prazos. Facilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente de startup dinâmico e em rápido crescimento. Fluência em português. Inglês será um grande diferencial. Qualificações Desejáveis Experiência como headhunter ou em agência de recrutamento. Experiência recrutando para empresas de EdTech, SaaS, inteligência artificial, educação, tecnologia ou startups. Experiência em contratações para as áreas de vendas, implantação, sucesso do cliente, operações, pedagogia ou liderança. Experiência recrutando profissionais seniores ou candidatos difíceis de encontrar. Familiaridade com o mercado de talentos brasileiro. Experiência na criação de matrizes de avaliação, estruturas de entrevistas e sistemas de avaliação de candidatos. Experiência trabalhando diretamente com fundadores, executivos ou equipes de alta liderança. O Que Procuramos Procuramos alguém que não seja apenas um recrutador, mas um verdadeiro caçador de talentos e parceiro estratégico de contratação. Você deverá ser capaz de compreender qual tipo de profissional a empresa realmente precisa, transformar necessidades de contratação pouco definidas em um perfil claro de candidato, encontrar profissionais qualificados de forma proativa e nos ajudar a evitar a contratação de pessoas que gerem mais necessidade de gestão do que valor para a empresa. A pessoa ideal é profissional, estável, madura, organizada e proativa. Deve trazer a disciplina e a estrutura de uma empresa maior, ao mesmo tempo que se sente confortável trabalhando em uma startup dinâmica, na qual as prioridades podem mudar rapidamente. Para Quem Esta Vaga Não É Indicada Esta vaga não é indicada para alguém que queira atuar apenas com atividades administrativas de Recursos Humanos. Esta vaga não é indicada para alguém que apenas publique oportunidades e espere que os candidatos se inscrevam. Esta vaga não é indicada para alguém que evite realizar abordagens proativas. Esta vaga não é indicada para alguém que precise de orientação constante. Esta vaga não é indicada para alguém com um histórico frequente de mudanças de emprego em períodos curtos, sem justificativas claras. Esta vaga não é indicada para alguém que não consiga trazer estrutura, disciplina e julgamento profissional ao processo de contratação.

title: Data Product Associate
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Product Associate em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About YipitData: YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare. Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world's largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact. We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc's Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency. With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets. About the Role: We currently have 60+ Data team members in our Investor business who build, create and maintain our data products, and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply. At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions. See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here! As a Data Associate, you will: Own high-impact data products end-to-end — driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You'll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients' key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You'll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights. Tackle complex data problems independently, using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous. Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage — significantly increasing speed, reducing manual work, and beginning to automate portions of workflows. You'll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs. This role will support the business in maintaining a strong compliance culture, managing regulatory relationships, and ensuring alignment with applicable legal and regulatory requirements. Working closely with local and regional stakeholders, the successful candidate will provide practical compliance guidance while supporting the company's growth and licensing initiatives in Brazil. Key Responsibilities Serve as the designated MLRO and lead compliance representative for the Brazil business. Oversee the company's compliance, AML/CFT, sanctions, and financial crime programs. Monitor regulatory developments and provide guidance on relevant regulatory requirements. Maintain relationships with regulators and support regulatory enquiries, reviews, and examinations. Support licensing, registration, and other regulatory initiatives as required. Provide compliance advice to business and operational teams on new products, services, and business activities. Help ensure policies, procedures, and controls remain effective and aligned with regulatory expectations. Oversee key compliance processes, including customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting. Identify compliance risks and work with stakeholders to implement appropriate controls and solutions. Prepare compliance updates and reporting for management. Deliver compliance training and promote a strong culture of compliance across the organization. Collaborate with regional and global teams on compliance-related matters. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, Accounting, or a related field. Experience in Compliance, AML/Financial Crime, Regulatory Affairs, or a related function within financial services, fintech, payments, banking, or digital assets. Prior experience as an MLRO, Compliance Officer, or similar compliance role is preferred. Good understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements and AML/CFT obligations. Experience interacting with regulators, auditors, or other external stakeholders is advantageous. Exposure to licensing, regulatory approvals, or compliance projects is beneficial. Experience within digital assets, fintech, payments, or financial institutions is preferred. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently in a dynamic and evolving environment. Professional certifications such as CAMS, ICA, CFE, or equivalent are a plus. Fluency in English and Portuguese. Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Confira esta oportunidade para Portuguese Language Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Overview: As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Annotation: Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision. Content Generation: Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs. Edge-Case Resolution: Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance. Continuous Feedback: Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations. Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots. System Requirements (Mandatory): Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Bring a compliant device. Windows 11 Pro (Home editions not allowed) or macOS 12+, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB free disk. Tablets/Chromebooks/phones won't be accepted. Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40MBPS Requirements: Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification. Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects. Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms. Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context. Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments. Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training. Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content. Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles. What We Offer: An innovative and supportive global working environment. Opportunities for continuous learning and growth. Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements. Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology. Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering solutions. Experience integrating and consuming LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar. Experience with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar solutions. Experience building or integrating AI agents and AI-assisted development workflows. Knowledge of backend development using Node.Js, Python, Java, .NET, or similar languages. Knowledge of APIs, REST services, contracts, and versioning. Experience with AI-assisted modernization and legacy migration strategies. Knowledge of Spec-Driven Development, Contract-First, or similar engineering approaches. Experience with Kubernetes, containers, and infrastructure automation. Knowledge of observability, security, and performance for AI systems in production. Experience working in consulting environments or embedded client delivery models. Experience enabling teams and scaling AI adoption across engineering organizations.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Visual Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Our culture isn't something people join, it's something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you're on the fence about whether you're a fit, we say go for it. Let's build something great together. We're looking for a Visual (Design Systems) Designer with exceptional visual design skills to support a large-scale Design System initiative for a leading enterprise software platform. This role is focused on visual exploration, design systems thinking, and crafting polished user interface experiences that can scale across complex products You'll work closely with an established Design System team to help define and evolve the visual language of the platform. This is a highly collaborative role where you'll explore design directions, create high-fidelity concepts, evaluate design solutions, and help bridge brand expression with scalable system design. Must Haves 5+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, or Visual Design roles with a strong emphasis on user interface design and visual craft. Outstanding visual design portfolio demonstrating excellence in typography, color systems, spacing, hierarchy, layout, iconography, and interaction design. Experience working within or contributing to design systems, with an understanding of how visual decisions scale across products and experiences. Strong understanding of enterprise software, complex workflows, information-dense interfaces, and interaction patterns. Familiarity with accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.1 AA, and experience incorporating accessibility considerations into visual design decisions Comfort working in ambiguous environments, synthesizing inputs, forming design recommendations, and defending design rationale with stakeholders. Strong communication and collaboration skills with designers, product managers, engineers, and business stakeholders. Nice to have Experience working on enterprise SaaS products. Previous involvement in Design System initiatives or component library evolution. Experience conducting competitive visual analysis and translating insights into design recommendations. Familiarity with Material UI (MUI) or other enterprise design system frameworks. Key Responsibilities Partner closely with the Design System team to explore and define future visual directions for enterprise software products. Explore, iterate, and refine visual design directions across areas such as color, typography, spacing, elevation, iconography, and overall product aesthetics. Create high-fidelity design concepts and prototypes that demonstrate how visual design decisions apply across real product workflows and use cases. Contribute to the development of scalable visual patterns that can be incorporated into the broader Design System. Support design evaluation activities by preparing assets, prototypes, and presentation materials for stakeholder reviews and user feedback sessions. Collaborate with product designers, researchers, engineers, and brand partners to align visual design direction with user needs and business goals. Help translate brand principles into practical, scalable Design System solutions that can be adopted across products, Advocate for accessibility, consistency, and usability throughout the design process. Contribute to a culture of design excellence through collaboration, critique, and thoughtful design discussion.

At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval. 2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration. 3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble 4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback. Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions. 5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines. 6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards. 7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows. 8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology 9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content. 10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork. Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Data Product Associate
description:

Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world's largest investment funds and corporations depend on. With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets. About the Role: We currently have 60+ Data team members in our Investor business who build, create and maintain our data products, and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply. At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions. See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here! As a Data Associate, you will: Own high-impact data products end-to-end — driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You'll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients' key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You'll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights. Tackle complex data problems independently, using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous. Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage — significantly increasing speed, reducing manual work, and beginning to automate portions of workflows. You'll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs. Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams — coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop technical solutions that streamline workflows, optimize data processes, and push the boundaries of automation. Identify and drive improvements to products and data pipelines, contributing ideas for new products, enhancements, and features. This could include developing new methodologies, exploring and scaling the use of new third-party datasets, or improving product profitability — all with a clear understanding of what drives value for clients. You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have 4–5+ years of experience in data, business, or predictive analytics and are proficient in SQL, Python, and PySpark You have a proven track record of quickly learning new concepts, particularly complex data methodologies, and building strong mental models of how and why data works You actively use AI tools (e.G., ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate your work and are excited about using AI to drive leverage — not just productivity, but fundamentally better and faster ways of working You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — both orally and in writing You have a strong ownership mentality and are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, independently prioritize tasks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information You have experience using sample or panel data to make precise estimates that guide decision-making You have a background in financial markets or are interested in learning more about data-driven investing You have an Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher) For You: Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Flexible work schedule Personal laptop Health and wellness package Remote work We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Our platform handles billions of database requests daily, and we're just getting started. Our customers are quantitative researchers, developers, and traders who ask technically sophisticated questions about financial data, APIs, and data integrity. You'll need to understand what they're asking and diagnose problems in depth. Your primary responsibility is to monitor Intercom and Discord to identify, triage, and respond to customer issues as they come in. When you can resolve an issue or provide a working workaround, you do it. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. We believe the most important feature is the one the customer already paid for. We take this promise seriously, and we want someone who will, too! What You'll Do Monitor Intercom and Discord and respond to incoming customer issues in a timely manner Diagnose technical problems related to API behavior, data quality, authentication, request handling, and account set-up Write and run Python scripts to reproduce issues and validate data against expected behavior Make REST API calls to investigate and isolate bugs or unexpected responses Provide workarounds and clear guidance to customers where possible Write thorough, reproducible Jira tickets and escalate unresolved issues Identify recurring issues and surface patterns to help prioritize fixes Create and maintain internal documentation on common issues, workarounds, and resolution steps What We're Looking For Required Experience working in a technical support or customer-facing engineering role Comfort working with REST APIs, including reading documentation, making requests, and interpreting responses Working knowledge of Python for scripting, data inspection, and reproducing issues Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both customers and engineers Detail-oriented and systematic approach to diagnosing problems Weekend support rotation Nice to Have Prior experience with financial data APIs Familiarity with financial data concepts (options, equities, market data, OHLCV, Greeks, etc.) Familiarity with Jira or similar issue tracking tools Experience with Intercom or similar support platforms Exposure to SQL or database queries for data validation Why Theta Data Rapid growth: the platform and team are both scaling fast Real challenges: data at scale, low-latency systems, complex financial data High ownership: a small team means your decisions matter;
you will influence howwe operate Remote-first: work from anywhere Direct impact: your work reaches thousands of quants and researchers daily A role that rewards genuine curiosity about financial data and technical problem-solving

title: Senior Revops Analyst - Churn
description:

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process. Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature. Why This Role Matters Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.
